subject: Payment terms and PO for Nexalytics pilot
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@nexalytics.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nexalytics Procurement <procurement@nexalytics.io>
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 09:13:00 +0000
Subject: Payment terms and PO for Nexalytics pilot

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward with the 6-week pilot. Attached is our PO (NEX-PO-451) and the procurement team asked for confirmation on payment terms before we sign:

- Requested payment terms: Net60
- Anticipated first invoice: upon pilot kick-off (week of July 7)
- Estimated monthly run-rate during pilot: ~€45k
- We are an EU company and will rely on reverse-charge for VAT; will share VAT ID in follow-up.

Given our internal approvals, Net60 is preferred. Also need a formal statement on how Redwood will invoice (one invoice per month, include PO number).

Please let me know if you can accept Net60 or propose an alternative. I copied procurement to keep the PO visible.

Best,
Oliver Grant
Head of Analytics Programs
Nexalytics
[Attachment: NEX-PO-451.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@nexalytics.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 12:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment terms and PO for Nexalytics pilot

Hi Oliver — great to hear and congrats on getting the PO queued. Quick note on terms and a pragmatic proposal so we can start next week: 

- Proposal: 30% upfront deposit to secure dedicated pilot capacity, remainder on Net45 from invoice date (we'll invoice monthly).
- Credit limit: for the pilot period we can set a provisional cap of €100,000. If usage/scope grows we can expand after a short credit check.
- VAT: we can apply reverse-charge invoicing for EU B2B customers; we'll need your VAT number and a signed EU VAT declaration form.

Kimberly / Rishi — can you review and confirm whether finance is comfortable with a provisional €100k cap and the 30% deposit? I attached a short SOW draft for signature to speed onboarding.

Next steps for Oliver: if that works, we'll send an amendment to the PO that lists the deposit and updated payment cadence and a DocuSign link for signatures.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198
[Attachment: SOW-draft-marissa-v1.docx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@nexalytics.io>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 08:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment terms and PO for Nexalytics pilot

Marissa / Rishi — reviewing. A few compliance / credit-control items from finance: 

- We can approve a provisional credit allowance up to €100k for a 6-week pilot, conditional on:
  - Receipt of 30% upfront deposit (cleared funds before kick-off)
  - Completed credit application (attached) and basic public-company check (or director references for private firms)
  - VAT evidence: EU VAT ID and confirmation of reverse-charge applicability (we need the VAT number to include on the invoice).
- If billing extends beyond 60 days or invoices go unpaid >30 days past Net45, account moves to credit-hold and services may be curtailed until remediated.
- For the PO: finance requires the PO number on each invoice and an invoice breakdown (deposit vs. recurring).

Oliver — attaching the credit application and a short checklist. If you can return VAT ID + signed credit app + confirm payment of the 30% deposit amount to the bank details in the doc, finance will issue the formal amendment and DocuSign envelope.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: credit-application-form.pdf]

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@nexalytics.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Nexalytics Procurement <procurement@nexalytics.io>
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 14:27:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment terms and PO for Nexalytics pilot

Marissa / Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround. We can accept the 30% upfront + Net45 remainder for the pilot; that aligns with our internal cashflow plan and gets the pilot moving. Action items from our side: 

- I'll upload our EU VAT ID and signed reverse-charge confirmation to the secure portal by EOD tomorrow.
- Procurement has signed the PO contingent on the amendment; I'll attach a countersigned copy once I receive the DocuSign envelope.
- We'll complete and return the credit application (low-touch) — expect it back within 24 hours.

Please send the formal amendment and DocuSign when ready and include the invoice schedule example (deposit invoice + month 1 invoice, etc.).

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to kickoff.

Best,
Oliver Grant
Head of Analytics Programs
Nexalytics
[Attachment: countersigned-PO-stub.pdf]
